nga-32577.text: A pale-skinned woman wearing a shimmering, pearl-white dress stands next to a harp, which is taller than she is, in this vertical portrait painting. The woman’s body faces us, but she angles her head slightly to our right. She looks up and off into the distance with gray-blue eyes under dark, curved brows. She has an oval face with a narrow chin. Her cheeks are flushed, and her full pink lips are closed. Her hair is pulled up, and chin-length curls frame her face. A ruffle, perhaps of lace, lines the low neckline of her dress, which has a sheen suggesting satin or silk.

nga-50460.text: The image shows three individuals and a baby. Two men stand side by side wearing animal hide leggings, with one holding a wooden staff. They have long dark hair and calm expressions. One man wears circular earrings and a necklace, and both have feathers in their hair. The woman, standing on the right, wears a white shawl over a blue skirt and a large nose ornament. She carries a swaddled baby on her back. The background shows an open landscape with grass and a cloudy blue sky. The scene is framed within an oval on a rectangular canvas with neutral-colored borders.

nga-1180.text: We find ourselves on an emerald-green, grassy racetrack as a dusty cluster of horses and their jockeys bear directly down on us in this loosely painted horizontal landscape. Closest to us, three horses run with their legs widely splayed and a fourth brings up the close rear to our left. Only closer inspection reveals a fifth horse nearby, seen over the shoulder of the jockey to our left of center. All the horses are chestnut brown except the second from our right, which is black. The faces of the jockeys are indistinct but they seem to have light skin.

nga-50588.text: The image shows a riverbank scene with a canoe on the water and various figures gathered on the bank. Small figures are engaged in different activities, surrounded by a forest in the background. The painting is detailed with smooth brushstrokes, primarily using earthy and natural tones. The artwork is enclosed in an oval frame.

nga-42504.text: This painting shows a white vase with gold trim and light blue shadows sitting in the center of a table, which is covered in a brown-and-white checkered cloth with fringed edges. The vase holds colorful flowers like tulips, daisies, and roses in shades of white, red, blue, orange, and pink, and the flowers are surrounded by green stems and leaves. On the table around the vase are several grapes, pears, and peaches in shades of yellow, pink, and blue-green. The background behind the vase and flowers is black.

nga-12206.text: A blue and white porcelain bowl, fruit, wine glasses, and a woven rug are gathered on a tabletop in front of a black background in this vertical still life painting. Light strongly illuminates the objects, creating a stark contrast to the dark background. At the center of the composition, the porcelain bowl is tipped so its wide brim rests on the rug bunched on the tabletop to our left. The rug is painted with a pattern in earthy beige and chocolate brown, denim blue, bronze, and cream white.

cma-125941.text: This whimsical series is one typically found in fashionable, elite Parisian residences of the eighteenth century. Panel paintings of this variety were created to decorate the space above chair rails and in between doors and windows, and Lancret's series was painted for a room in the Pavillon d'Hauteville in Paris. In keeping with the eighteenth-century French tradition of depicting the four seasons or the times of the day, Lancret's five decorative panels have a unifying theme.

cma-677517.text: Sita exclaims to Rama, “What an exquisite deer! He has stolen my heart away. Please catch him for me, my great-armed husband. He shall be our plaything. . . . Never before have we seen an animal such as this. His body sparkles with different colors and is speckled with chips of precious stones; he illuminates the entire forest, for with his golden hide and horns of precious gems, he shows all the brilliance of the morning sun, all the luster of the starry heavens.” Lakshmana is suspicious and warns against having anything to do with the enchanting deer.

nga-52229.text: Shown from the waist up, a woman with light, peachy-yellow skin sits with her body facing us as she looks over her shoulder to our right in this loosely painted, vertical portrait. Her face is in profile and her carnation-pink and tangerine-orange hair is pulled into a bun at the base of her head. Fluffy bangs are parted over her forehead and obscure her eyes. Her snub nose is reddened, and her pink lips are pursed. She wears a long sleeved, tight fitting, black blouse with bright orange trim along one side of the shallow, V-shaped neckline.

nga-50458.text: The image shows four Native American individuals. Three of them are standing, with one kneeling or sitting on the ground. The central figure, a woman, is standing upright and covered with a draped cloth. Her hair is long and is decorated with two feathers. A young child is standing next to her, visible from the waist up. To the right, a man stands holding a spear in one hand and has a bow slung over his shoulder. His long hair is styled back, and he wears minimal clothing, with a piece of cloth wrapped around his waist. On the left, another figure is seated, holding a wrapped bundle.

nga-164962.text: This painting shows an expansive green and yellow grassland under a textured blue and white sky. The horizon line is high, separating the fields and clouds with a thin line of dark trees and small white buildings. The dark silhouette of a small person is in the grass to the left, and a tall tree is in the background on the far-left side. Small dashes of blue and peach paint decorate the grass, and there are streaks of red and peach in the sky. The brushstrokes are short and feathery, giving the scene a blurred quality.

nga-204911.text: The painting is a landscape featuring a riverbank with tall, dark-green trees on the left side and distant blue hills in the background. The shore on the left is covered is tall yellow and green grass and dotted with pink and white flowers below the dark green trees. The water on the right is light blue, reflecting the blue sky and the thick white clouds.

nga-172073.text: Shown from the knees up, a woman stands facing and looking at us with her head tilted a little to our left in this vertical portrait painting. She has pale skin, a heart-shaped face with rosy cheeks, and a rose-pink bow mouth. Thin, arched, sable-brown eyebrows frame her gray eyes. A wreath of pale pink flowers and curling white ostrich feathers crowns her long gray hair, which is piled high on her head. Loose curly tendrils brush both shoulders.

nga-222287.text: A large cluster of green grapes hangs prominently in the upper center of this painting, accompanied by an intertwined vine and a single olive-green leaf. One of the grapes at the center of the bunch is a golden color, while the others are light green. Below the grapes, two round red fruits rest on the surface of a table, one with an opening that reveals a light orange interior. A delicate blue butterfly flutters to the left of the grapes, and a small red ladybug sits at the edge of the table at the bottom of the painting.

cma-169767.text: This painting depicts a canal in Gisors, a commune in Normandy, about 40 miles northwest of Paris on the river Epte. Le Sidaner painted this work in a Divisionist technique of applying pure color in large, broken strokes, often separated by areas of white or gray. Unlike the Impressionists, Le Sidaner preferred a restrained palette of delicately nuanced tones that evoke a mood of quiet mystery.

cma-132924.text: Zha Shibiao, a native of Anhui province, moved to Yangzhou later in his career, like so many of his fellow countrymen. At age 68, he painted this album with seasonal landscapes in various styles. Painted in fresh colors and wet strokes, all depict typical scenes of Jiangnan, the Yangzi delta: a herdboy on a buffalo wading through water, boating on the stream to the Peach Blossom Spring at Wulin, a waterfront town shrouded in mist, a scholar on his donkey enjoying the red autumn leaves, and drinking tea on a boat while watching migrating birds.

nga-46440.text: The image portrays a woman in a profile view, with her head turned towards the left. She has medium-length dark hair styled back, wearing a high-collared garment with ruffled edges. She has a sharp nose, defined cheekbones, and a firm chin. The background is a plain, light-colored canvas, and the artist's signature "A. Legros" and the year "1875" are seen in the upper right corner.

nga-56740.text: The image depicts two individuals standing side by side. They both have light brown hair, light skin, round eyes, and slightly flushed cheeks. They are wearing deep blue garments with white ruffled collars and two yellow buttons. The background is a flat, dark brown color.

nga-117958.text: From a rocky ledge, we look down into a valley between two humped mountains that run into the distance ahead of us in this horizontal landscape painting. The area closest to us has golden yellow and sage-green grasses on a ledge of ash-gray stone. The land drops away beyond the ledge, into a valley, which is also deep in shadow. The conical tops of a few evergreen trees poke up on the far side of the stone ledge. The flat, grassy area between the mountains is moss and olive green.

nga-50602.text: The painting shows a scene with dense jungle vegetation viewed from a riverbank. The horizon is low, defined by the water meeting the greenery. The vegetation is depicted with intricate brushwork, portraying a tropical environment with a green color palette. A canoe with two figures is seen on the water, while dense foliage adds depth in the background.

nga-118801.text: This painting shows a bouquet of various colorful flowers bursting out of a glass vase. A large, bright orange lily is at the center, surrounded by a variety of large and small flowers in red, white, blue, yellow, and pink, with a large blue iris in the top right corner. Some flowers are drooping over the top of the vase, and a few small ones have fallen to the table below. The glass vase is packed with the long green stems of the flowers, giving it a green appearance.

nga-121104.text: The painting depicts birch trees and autumn foliage. The composition is filled with white-gray tree trunks and colorful leaves. The largest tree is to the right of center, beginning at the bottom of the painting and appearing to continue beyond the upper edge. The color palette includes deep oranges, reds, and yellows for the leaves, with some dark blues and greens suggesting shadows. The dark-blue sky is partially visible behind a tree on the left. The paint has been applied in thick, swirling strokes.

cma-125093.text: Although French by birth, Claude Lorrain spent his entire working career in Rome. He revolutionized the art of landscape painting by filling his harmoniously ordered scenes (inspired by the campagna, the countryside around Rome) with a golden, hazy light. Painted early in Lorrain's career, Italian Landscape shows a wide, sweeping vista with a wooded hill topped by a structure resembling an ancient Roman temple. The left side of the picture is dark, but the foreground sweeps away in a curve to the right that leads off into an increasingly luminous distance.

cma-132930.text: Zha Shibiao, a native of Anhui province, moved to Yangzhou later in his career, like so many of his fellow countrymen. At age 68, he painted this album with seasonal landscapes in various styles. Painted in fresh colors and wet strokes, all depict typical scenes of Jiangnan, the Yangzi delta: a herdboy on a buffalo wading through water, boating on the stream to the Peach Blossom Spring at Wulin, a waterfront town shrouded in mist, a scholar on his donkey enjoying the red autumn leaves, and drinking tea on a boat while watching migrating birds.

nga-46556.text: Shown from the chest up, a pale-skinned man in a suit sits in a high-backed chair, looking slightly to our right in this vertical portrait painting. His eyes and head are both turned slightly to our right, with only one ear visible on our left. His shoulder on our right and the right side of the chair are slightly cut off by the edge of the painting. He has a straight nose, high cheekbones, and pale pink closed lips. His eyes are dark, with small shadows beneath them. His black, wavy hair is parted on our right and cropped short on the sides of his head, with thick, defined waves on top.

nga-50530.text: The image shows five individuals standing in various positions. They have distinctive facial features, long black hair styled with feathers, and minimal clothing made from animal skins. Some have painted patterns or tattoos on their bodies. They hold objects like spears or staffs adorned with feathers. In the background is a light, neutral-colored backdrop with a hint of blue and sparse vegetation, indicating an outdoor setting.

nga-195122.text: Lush treetops give way to a body of water and a hill in this loosely painted horizontal landscape. The trees across the bottom edge of the canvas are painted with visible or blended strokes in shades of spring, pine, and forest green, aquamarine, and midnight blue. The body of water is skimmed with pale peach, yellow, and blue before the hill rises to nearly touch the top edge of the painting. The vegetation on the hill is painted in shades of celery and olive green, navy and cobalt blue, and a few touches of rust red. Strokes of ivory white suggest houses clustered near the shoreline.

nga-50528.text: The image shows a circular framed scene viewed at a slight downward angle. The serene nighttime landscape includes a group of figures gathered around a small campfire. Lush silhouettes of trees rise to the left, blending into the night sky. In the lower part of the frame, a vast expanse of water or a lake meets the sky, reflecting the moonlight partially obscured by clouds. The brushstrokes are smooth, offering a sense of calm stability. The color palette consists of deep blues, blacks, and subtle crimson tones from the campfire, creating an atmosphere of quiet stillness and soft light.

nga-43439.text: The image shows a child standing with both hands in front. The child has a full face, large, round eyes, and fair, short, curly hair. They are wearing a dress with blue and orange stripes and small floral patterns, white pants, and black shoes. The child holds a thin stick in one hand and a wide-brimmed straw hat with a blue bow in the other. A small black dog stands at the child's left side, appearing to sniff a leafy branch. The background features soft green hills, scattered trees, and a light sky.

nga-56734.text: The image displays a still life arrangement of various fruits on an intricate pedestal. It includes a watermelon slice, pineapple, lemons, orange, grapes, peaches, and berries among others. Colors range from deep greens to vibrant yellows, reds, and soft pinks set against a dark background. Fruits are centrally placed, with the watermelon forming a horizontal base near the top of the pedestal, while the pineapple and citrus fruits are stacked above it, slightly right of center.

cma-98215.text: This painting demonstrates Cox's ideas about the importance in art of tradition and the classical spirit. Two figures in Grecian costumes, representing the arts of the past, pass on the eternal flame of tradition to two figures in Renaissance dress. Literature wears the laurel crown, and Painting holds the palette. Born in Warren, Ohio, Cox studied art in Cincinnati and at the Pennsylvania Academy of Fine Arts in Philadelphia. In 1877, he moved to Paris to study under Carolus Duran (1838-1917) and Jean-Léon Gérôme (1824-1904).

cma-151343.text: Ōmi is an area around Lake Biwa near Kyoto. The Shinto shrine Hiyoshi Taisha and the Buddhist temple Ishiyamadera are in the upper right and upper left of the composition, respectively. At center is the pilgrimage route and people in the town before the temple gates. Harvested rice fields to the right and flowering cherry blossom trees at left show seasonal change from winter to spring.

nga-3211.text: The portrait shows a woman from the waist up. She is facing the viewer with her body slightly turned to the right. Her right hand is touching her cheek. She has finely arched eyebrows, large eyes, and a small mouth. Her dark hair is styled elegantly with ringlets. She wears a gray dress with a wide neckline, lace cuffs, and a brooch at the center of her chest. The background is a blend of brown and ochre tones.

nga-50443.text: This is a painting of a group of figures arranged in a circular formation. The figures are painted with vibrant red hues on their heads, carrying spears or sticks. The background is light tan with hints of blue and green. The style of the figures and their attire imply a cultural or historical narrative. The painting is in the style of George Catlin.

nga-52198.text: A woman bends double to tend a garden that stretches before us in front of two houses in this horizontal landscape painting. The scene is painted with short, visible brushstrokes with a palette dominated by spring, pine, and celery green and earthy tan, peanut, and chestnut brown. Touches of canary yellow, pale pink, coral, and ruby red suggest sunflowers, roses, and other flowers. The woman wears a long, steel-gray skirt and a long-sleeved olive-green shirt. Her brown hair is bound up, and her face and hands, indicated with only a few short swipes of paint, are pale peach.

nga-139458.text: A river spans the lower edge of this horizontal landscape painting, and winds into the distance to our right, below towering white clouds in a blue sky above. The clouds sweep up and toward us from the low horizon line, which is about a quarter of the way up the canvas. Rowboats, sailboats, and ducks dot the river to our right. The long, shallow ferry boat near the bottom center of the painting transports a pair of horses and a carriage, which is occupied by at least four seated people. More men, women, and a nursing woman fill the ferry around the carriage and animals.

nga-59928.text: The image shows a woman in a full-length portrait. She has a pale complexion, arched eyebrows, a small mouth, and dark eyes. She wears a cap, a red and gold dress with white lace detailing, and floral patterns. Her shoes are visible beneath the dress, and she wears a pearl necklace. She holds a dark object in one hand and has the other hand on her waist. The background is dark with flowers on the left and a pattern of roses on the right.

cma-148365.text: The location of this scene, probably near Paris, has not been identified with certainty. Unlike most painters of this time, Michel never traveled to Italy and focused only on depicting locations in France. Michel was always interested in Dutch art, however, and was nicknamed the "French Ruisdael"-a reference to the 17th-century Dutch landscape painter Jacob van Ruisdael (1628-1682). After about 1808, Michel explored personal interpretations of landscape, focusing on light, sky, and space.

cma-151344.text: Ōmi is an area around Lake Biwa near Kyoto. The Shinto shrine Hiyoshi Taisha and the Buddhist temple Ishiyamadera are in the upper right and upper left of the composition, respectively. At center is the pilgrimage route and people in the town before the temple gates. Harvested rice fields to the right and flowering cherry blossom trees at left show seasonal change from winter to spring.

nga-565.text: Shown from the chest up, an older man with pale, peachy skin, wearing a high-collared black coat and a cream-white, ruffled collar, is shown against a deep wine-red background in this vertical portrait painting. His body is angled to our right, and he turns his face to look at us with gray eyes under pale gray eyebrows. He has a hooked nose and jowls along his chin line. His cheeks are flushed, and his lips are set in a line. His white hair flares out along the sides of his head and is tied at the nape of his neck with a ribbon loosely painted and outlined with black.

nga-41685.text: An elderly man kneels and leans back with his arms spread wide as he gazes up at another older man sitting in a chariot made of flames and pulled by white horses, which are held aloft by fawn-brown, puffy clouds, in this horizontal painting. Both men have pale skin and are partially bald with full beards. To our left, the kneeling man is mostly turned away from us, so we see the back of his ash-blond hair, a deeply furrowed brow, and a hooked nose. His head tips back and his mouth hangs open. He wears a long, mahogany-brown robe with a flax-yellow mantle draped over his left shoulder.

nga-46475.text: A wide, placid river winds through a hazy landscape with a grassy bank to the left and a sheer rock formation to the right in this horizontal painting. The water tumbles down step-like rapids near the center of the composition in the middle distance. To our right, a ruined building nestled among trees stands atop a rocky outcropping that extends about a third of the way across the painting. Two tall, spindly trees grow on a lower, grassy bank to the left. A waterfall pours from a narrow gap in more rocky cliffs to the left, farther back than the rapids.

nga-50577.text: The image depicts a dense jungle scene viewed from slightly above water level. The horizon is obscured by thick greenery, including palm fronds, vines, and colorful flowers. In the foreground, a narrow canoe-like boat carries three figures: one standing in the boat and two working by the water's edge. The detailed brushwork emphasizes the leaves and foliage, creating a rich tapestry of greens with bright blossoms. The earth-toned border complements the lush wilderness depicted, drawing the viewer into the jungle.

nga-54976.text: A tall goblet made with a spiraling nautilus shell on a gold and silver stem, a blue and white lidded, porcelain bowl, an orange, a cut lemon, and a bunched up, woven rug are gathered on a tabletop in front of a black background in this vertical still life painting. Light falling on the objects from our left contrasts sharply with the deep shadow beyond, which makes some details difficult to make out. The objects might be gathered on a silver tray. At the center of the composition, the flagon is made with a shimmering, ivory-colored nautilus shell with its wide opening facing up.

cma-144431.text: The painting is characteristic of Jan Siberechts's Antwerp style, characterized by scenes with fords through which peasants wade with their cattle. The peasants wear simple but brightly colored attire and stand out against the cool green landscape. Flanked by overgrown foliage, the silver hues of the still stream shimmer with reflections. Over the course of his career, which included moving to London in 1672, Siberechts continued to use many of the same figures in his paintings, including Flemish peasant women carrying jugs, like the one seen in this painting.

cma-140445.text: Views of Tiger Hill depicts a historic site a few miles northwest of Suzhou. The scenes simulate a visit from arriving by boat at the foot of the mountain to climbing to Cloudy Cliff Monastery. Representations of the artist’s mature style, Shen Zhou included views in subtle colors in the suite of monochrome scenes. A Suzhou native, Shen Zhou was supported by family wealth and rejected an official career in favor of life as a retired scholar. Turning to painting in midlife, he is regarded as the founder of the Wu School of painting, with its center in Suzhou.

nga-46506.text: In shades of mint, laurel, and eucalyptus green, the head and shoulders of a chubby baby fill this vertical portrait painting. It is created with long, visible brushstrokes, some of which are thick enough to cast shadows onto the canvas beneath. The baby’s skin is painted with cool, light green, with peach-colored highlights. The baby has large, vivid blue eyes gazing intently down and off to our right, full lips, and chubby cheeks. The white garment comes to the baby’s elbows, and the pudgy fingers touch.

nga-221200.text: This painting shows four individuals gathered together. They all have light skin and are elaborately dressed. On the far left is a woman with golden curls, a gold necklace, and a crown-like headpiece playing a lute. She wears a vibrant red dress with a white bodice and lace on the sleeves and neckline. On top of it is a green shawl with braided straps. On the right is a man with curly hair wearing a large, tan hat adorned with a white-and-blue plume, a tan doublet with blue feathers or fabric down the middle, tan shorts, and white stockings tied with blue ribbons above blue shoes.

nga-166432.text: Two men, a woman, and three children, all with brown skin, gather around a table in a house in this horizontal painting. A bespectacled, white-haired man sits to our left, wearing a black coat and suit. He looks up and to our right, his chin slightly lifted. A black top hat and a book sit near his feet, and a gray umbrella leans against the back of his worn wooden chair. Opposite him, to our right, a younger man has short black hair and a trimmed beard. He props one elbow on a cigar box on the table and rests his chin in that hand.

nga-35092.text: This painting shows a maritime scene with a setting sun at the center, illuminating the scene in yellow light. In the bottom left corner, people stand on a stone ledge, looking out across the water. Some of them are in small rowboats or larger sailing boats that float across the water. A large tower or castle surrounded by tall trees is on the edge of the water on the left, with more people sitting or standing around it. In the distance on the right, misty, light blue mountains are visible behind tall sailing ships that all face towards the setting sun.

nga-46553.text: This painting shows a large jug filled with orange flowers on a woven brown surface, with three small oranges placed in front of it. The bottom half of the jug is a brownish-red color, while the top part and handles are a light tan. The jug is centered, with flowers extending slightly to the sides. The flowers in the vase are surrounded by dark green leaves and buds. The wall behind the vase is a light gray color, and the vase casts a light shadow on it.

nga-111627.text: A dish of about two dozen figs, a crusty loaf of bread, a tall, black flask, and two wooden vessels are closely gathered on a wooden table or ledge in this vertical still life painting. At the front right, the figs are either deep purple or pale green. The shallow, pale lavender-gray dish in which they are piled has a narrow, scalloped edge. The round loaf of golden-brown bread, with its split top, sits behind and to our left of the figs. In the lower left corner, next to the figs and closest to us, the handle of a knife projects toward us. Its pewter-colored blade angles back away from us.

cma-135143.text: The mid-17th century saw revived interest in representations of the lower classes. Artists like the Le Nain brothers in France painted scenes that looked back to the Renaissance tradition of pastoral imagery. The Le Nain often depicted ordinary country folk going about their daily business, subjects and figures they remembered from their childhood in rural Laon. Considered a companion piece to Peasant Children Dancing (1958.175.2), Vintage Scene has also been attributed to the Master of the Béguins, a Flemish artist who worked in the manner of the Le Nain in Paris.

cma-148538.text: Responding to the desires of the middle class ( chonin ), some late Edo period Japanese painters moved away from the seriousness associated with the Chinese theme of reclusion, focusing instead on the motif’s humorous aspects. The theme Eight Immortals of the Wine Cup is based on a poem by the renowned 8th-century Chinese poet Du Fu about his eight colleagues. These scholars eagerly sought release from their official governmental duties and then supposedly fled the capital for the countryside.

nga-56916.text: Shown from the chest up, a cleanshaven, middle-aged man with pale skin and silvery gray hair, wearing a white, ruffled shirt under a velvety black, high-necked jacket, looks out at us in this vertical portrait painting. His body is angled to our left, and he turns his face slightly to look at us with gray eyes under slightly arched eyebrows. He has a long nose and his thin lips are closed in a straight line. Shadows define slightly sagging jowls along his jawline and down his neck. His light gray hair is pulled back from his forehead and swells in bushy curls over his ears.

nga-69367.text: This is an oval painting of a celestial scene featuring divine and angelic figures among clouds. In the center of the painting, a man sits on a cloud, with one arm outstretched and the other holding a large globe. This man has gray hair and wears a red garment with a deep blue cloth draped over his waist that floats up behind his head. The man is surrounded on either side by human figures with wings, some sitting on different clouds while others fly in the air. The sky behind these figures is a deep blue with fluffy white clouds.

nga-164963.text: This painting shows a scene with several people spaced out across a grassy expanse. The horizon is high in the painting, lined with white structures with red roofs and green trees. Closest to us are the silhouettes of several people engaged in leisurely activities. One person appears to sit on a grass hill, while others walk in opposite directions down a path, two holding umbrellas. The people are painted with thick, dark paint strokes, and have no detail inside their forms. Behind them, towards the horizon, is a wide pink stretch that could be a river or a path.

nga-33747.text: This painting shows a fleet of sailing ships on choppy water. The horizon is low, and ship sails and masts are visible far in the distance. Closest to us, five large ships are visible. Four of them are large vessels with multiple masts and sails, while one is a smaller sailboat with two sails. This smaller boat is to the right of center, and two small people are visible on it, holding ropes. To the left is the largest boat, which we see from the back. This ship is painted in a dark gray or blue color, with red accents and decorations that appear to be carved or painted on the sides.

nga-118800.text: This painting shows a bouquet of various colorful flowers bursting out of a glass vase. Two large red and cream tulips are at the top of the bouquet, surrounded by smaller flowers in red, blue, white, pale yellow, and pale purple. Some flowers are drooping over the top of the vase, and a few green leaves and pink buds have fallen to the table below. The glass vase is packed with the long green stems of the flowers, giving it a green appearance. The vase rests on a light gray table, and there is a red and black beetle on the left.
